exact_statement: For every indicator g on a finite uniform cube, f=1-2g and every nonempty physical queried block A, let Lambda_A(g)=F(g)-E_xF(g_x) be the raw bit Fourier-entropy drop and L_A(f)=H(f)-E_xH(f_x). Then L_A(f)<=4Lambda_A(g)+(4/(e ln2))I_A(f), including zero-energy blocks. The exact empty-coefficient correction is T(p)=-(1-2p)^2 ln((1-2p)^2)+4p^2 ln(p^2)-8ln2 p(1-p), with T(p)-E T(p_x)<=(8/e)Ent(p_x)<=16E_A(g)/e. For every finite adaptive physical restriction tree the same transfer holds for total entropy decrements and erased influence, retaining actual leaf entropies and the inherited indicator orientation. If g has actual connected components with pairwise disjoint projections on a proper r-coordinate block A, masses p_k and projection measures mu_k satisfying sum p_k log2(1/mu_k)>=r E g/2, then L_A(f)<=C_proj I_A(f), C_proj=4+2/ln2+4/(e ln2)<37/4<10. Thus every physical-descendant ratio-critical sign in this geometric class has H/I<=C_proj at every positive support density, and every least-essential-dimension K-violator is excluded from it at K>=C_proj with the complete child reserve retained. Universal proper-block admission is not asserted.
hypotheses: Finite uniform physical cubes; Boolean indicators g and actual signs f=1-2g; raw indicator entropy F and sign entropy H in bits; I_A(f)=4E_A(g)
Universal block/tree transfer uses actual fair physical restrictions and the same inherited indicator orientation at every leaf; no density or component hypothesis
Projection critical consequence requires a proper nonempty block, actual connected-component projections pairwise disjoint, and weighted projection information at least r E g/2

Critical ratio conclusion requires all proper physical descendant ratios at most the root ratio and nonzero influence; threshold exclusion requires least essential dimension among all Boolean fixed-K violators
No arbitrary virtual component or row phase is treated as a physical descendant; every child/terminal deficit is retained
